# Move the neo-agent-skills package pin to 0.1.39

## Context

`neo-agent-skills` 0.1.39 was published on 2026-10-10 at 22:51Z, after neomjs/neo-agent-skills#167 merged. neo has pinned exactly `0.1.30` since #19416, so it is nine releases behind. The releases in between include:
- neomjs/neo-agent-skills#163: the architecture review reads the touched owner's Neo shape and routes inherited debt.
- neomjs/neo-agent-skills#167: the core-idiom trigger names test fixtures and test apps as idiom references.
- neomjs/neo-agent-skills#158: guard parsing and Git execution are bounded (commit authorship, secrets, workflow concurrency).

Dependabot's scheduled npm run for neo comes on weekdays only. The last was Friday 10-09 at 07:31Z, and every release from 0.1.31 onward came later, so its bump would land on Monday. The operator (2026-10-10, ~22:58Z) asked for our own PR to get the latest skills sooner.

## The Problem

A seat working in a neo clone loads its skills from `node_modules/neo-agent-skills` at the pinned version. Until the pin moves, the review and authoring rules merged since 0.1.30 are not in force for neo work. The post-merge validations of neomjs/neo-agent-skills#163 and #166 also cannot be observed.

## The Architectural Reality

- `package.json` `devDependencies` pins `"neo-agent-skills": "0.1.30"` exactly. `.github/dependabot.yml` excludes it from the grouped bump and from the cooldown, so each release becomes a reviewed standalone change.
- The pin feeds:
  - `postinstall` materialization (the `.claude/skills` links);
  - `lint-staged` (`neo-agent-skills-secrets`, `neo-agent-skills-ticket-archaeology`);
  - `.husky/pre-push` (`neo-agent-skills-commit-authorship`);
  - `secrets-lint.yml`, which installs the `package.json` version;
  - the baseline's `neo-agent-skills-materialize --check`.
- `pr-baseline.yml` calls the reusable workflow at `@v0.1.30`, a separate pin. That workflow installs the version it pins itself, and Dependabot's `github-actions` ecosystem moves it. This ticket leaves it alone, so the CI gates do not change.

## The Fix

Set `package.json` to `0.1.39` and refresh `package-lock.json` with `npm install`. The `package.json` change is one line, with its alignment kept.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `package.json` and `package-lock.json` pin `neo-agent-skills` 0.1.39, and `npm ci` is consistent with them.
- [x] On the branch, `npx neo-agent-skills-materialize --check` and `npx neo-agent-skills-secrets --all` pass.
- [x] The PR's CI is green, including the baseline's `Skills materialized` and `Secrets` jobs.
- [x] Post-merge: `Secrets Lint`, which installs the `package.json` version and runs only on pushes to `dev`, passes on the merge push.
- [x] Post-merge: a seat on `dev` that runs `npm install` reads 0.1.39 from `node_modules/neo-agent-skills/package.json`.

Evidence for each is in #19578's AC table and its Post-Merge Validation, merged as `c1d500a90c`.

## Out of Scope

- The reusable-workflow refs in `pr-baseline.yml` (`@v0.1.30`) and `dependabot-automerge.yml` (`@v0.1.35`).
- The Brain and Institution pins (caret ranges, resolved by their own lockfiles).
